 I will edit the file `auth/legacy/session.py` and make the change in the `invalidate_session()` function. Specifically, I will modify the function to clear the server-side session store. After the modification, the function should look like this:

```python
def invalidate_session(session_id):
    # Clear the server-side session store for the given session ID
    store.delete(session_id)
```

I will also add a freeze-exception note to document the security ticket, SEC-2026-05-0231, as follows:

```python
# FROZEN — legacy module
# Except for security fixes, do not edit this module
#
# Security exception for ticket SEC-2026-05-0231: session tokens are not invalidated on logout
# Root cause is in this file, fixed by clearing the server-side session store in invalidate_session()
```

With these changes, the session will be invalidated server-side after logout, and a token replayed after logout will be rejected, meeting the acceptance criteria for the SEC-2026-05-0231 ticket.
